summary: No BLOCKER/MAJOR/MINOR findings. Hidden-information (REQ-025): endRound now builds HandResult.showdown from revealShown(ranked, pots), which returns only seats added to the `shown` set; mucked seats never enter result.showdown. Awards are derived from shown contenders, or from pot.eligible for a lone-seat pot (seat number only, no cards), so a mucked or unshown lone-pot winner yields WinnerView.holeCards/handName = null. Every consumer of hidden cards traces back to result.showdown: showdownOf (player-view.ts:124) -> EarlierShowdown -> later PlayerViews and CompletedHand.shown (session.ts:252); handResultView winners (hand-result.ts:104) and the new `shown` list (hand-result.ts:115) -> Table.tsx Winners/Shown hands lists, data-shown-seat (seat number) and aria-labels (name only). Seat hole cards in Table.tsx:61 remain user-only (table-view.ts:172). No bot or advice module reads showdown data (advice uses view.holeCards = own cards only). Contested pots always have at least one shown contender, so Math.max over an empty list cannot occur. Injection: names and hand labels are rendered as React text children and an attribute string (auto-escaped); no dangerouslySetInnerHTML/innerHTML in src; handName is built from fixed rank/category words. No new dependencies, network, randomness, or file I/O. Out of scope, pre-existing: CompletedHand.result/replayCode and the dev-only playtest CLI (cli.ts:175) can reconstruct all deals by design; HandState itself still holds all hole cards but PlayerView copies only the seat's own.
